applicabilityBasis.summary: XMD is a U.S.-linked stablecoin index redeemable against a basket of reserve-backed dollar stablecoins rather than a standalone fiat-reserve issuance.

genius.notes: XMD has payment and settlement use cases, but its documented 1:1 redemption delivers an available supported digital-dollar reserve asset. GENIUS section 2(22) excludes digital assets from the fixed monetary value required for the issuer redemption obligation. The opened documents do not establish an additional legally obligated national-currency redemption issuer, so applicability remains unclear. Metallicus supplies infrastructure and Metal DAO governs basket changes. Those roles do not identify an exact legal redemption obligor or its domicile. The pre-sweep composite issuerEntity, Metallicus / Metal DAO, is retained as an operator/governance descriptor because removal of the load-bearing identity was not established at high confidence. This retained descriptor does not establish an exact legal issuer or a GENIUS-authorized entity. Issuer domicile remains unverified and is omitted. GENIUS educational and CIP-alignment articles, institutional contract updates, and credit-union pilot activity do not establish XMD-specific intent to seek PPSI authorization. Treasury balances and company quarterly reports do not establish monthly independent reserve assurance. No named token-specific public approval, official application or enforcement action was located as of 2026-10-07. Treasury August 17 proposed timing expects core activation January 18, 2027 and the broader DASP restriction July 18, 2028; the issuer explainer's enactment and activation dates are not used as legal authority.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No opened primary issuer or public regulator source identified XMD-specific PPSI approval, state qualification or official GENIUS application. First-party GENIUS positioning concerns basket interoperability or other institutions' issuance infrastructure, without identifying an XMD legal obligor or application. Public-domain searches and the OCC pending-charter table returned no relevant named issuer. The negative finding does not establish an exemption, legal non-compliance or the absence of unpublished filings.
